decisions.reason: As the publicly presented flagship product line with multiple models and high sunk investment, visibility, and centrality, escalation of commitment makes withdrawal very unlikely.
Although it has only a website mention and low public commitment, it is tied to the established offer and still useful, so we keep it but with a clear risk of future withdrawal.
Its own page and alignment with the firm's digital direction give it moderate visibility and centrality, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal relatively unlikely.
As a complete bundle close to the established offer and presented on its own page, it has high commitment and centrality, making withdrawal very unlikely.
Distant from the established offer with only a website mention, it has low sunk investment, low visibility, and low centrality, so escalation of commitment does not protect it from withdrawal.
